stories.title: Leafs blow another lead as winless run continues
stories.summary: Jim Hiller was behind the bench with his Maple Leafs desperately hanging onto a one-goal lead.

stories.title: Columbus tops Toronto to extend Leafs’ winless run
stories.summary: Zach Werenski scored with 3:28 left in regulation as the Columbus Blue Jackets battled back late to top Toronto 4-3 and extend the Maple Leafs' winless streak to nine games Saturday.

stories.title: Toronto man arrested for homicide after appearing on Canada’s most wanted list
stories.summary: In September 2026, officers responded to a report of a vehicle on fire in a field near the Steeles Avenue East and Reesor Road area, where they found a 32-year-old man dead inside.

stories.title: Toronto zoo reviews enclosures and policies following Fiona the Hippo’s death
stories.summary: Beloved nine-year-old Fiona died from complications after ingesting a visitor's knit hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.

stories.title: Navdeep Bains named new Ontario Liberal leader
stories.summary: Bains is new to provincial elected office, but previously represented Mississauga ridings federally and served as federal minister of innovation, science and industry.

stories.title: Stellantis meeting ‘challenging’ but ‘productive’, Premier Ford says
stories.summary: The meeting came as Minister of Industry Mélanie Joly said the automaker can either keep its Brampton plant open or face a multimillion-dollar lawsuit from the federal government.

stories.title: Alleged Toronto faction of Italy-based mafia group sanctioned by U.S.
stories.summary: A Canadian faction of an alleged organized crime group founded in southern Italy has been sanctioned by the United States Treasury Department.

stories.title: Ontario, Ottawa committing $250M to help fund new port in Sault Ste. Marie
stories.summary: Ontario and the federal government say they're committing $250 million to help build a new port in Sault Ste. Marie on the north shore of the Saint Marys River.

stories.title: Kings’ Adrian Kempe fined for high-sticking Joshua
stories.summary: The NHL fined Los Angeles Kings forward Adrian Kempe US$3,500 Friday for high-sticking Toronto Maple Leafs forward Dakota Joshua.

stories.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
stories.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.
